answer_1.quote: By calculating perplexity-based reward based on the model's reasoning process, it enables incentivedriven reinforcement learning across a wide range of text-to-text tasks

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we report accuracy on all datasets. For choice questions, we extend the extractor from to identify both the option letter and corresponding text, then match against ground truth

answer_3.quote: For open-ended QA, we use Gemini-2.0-flash in an LLM-as-a-Judge setup

answer_4.quote: To further validate the gains, we conducted human evaluations on each rubric dimension comparing stories from standard NOVER and the rubric-trained variant
answer_4.guideline: Annotators expressed preferences for each story concerning rubrics: Clear Structure, Describe more than Direct, Appropriate Perspective, Positive Tone, Accurate Expression, Appropriate Vocabulary
